entries.rationale: This preservation ref contains the earlier one-commit public typed request execution boundary. The current main/convergence tree already retains that behavior: the public laplace_cognition_observation_request_execute declaration, its compile/provider/forward lifecycle implementation, execution-failure disposition, and the PublicExecuteOwnsCompileProviderAndForwardLifecycle regression are present in the current engine. The later repair/cognition-request-execute vehicle is already recorded as superseded by merged PR #234. Replaying this older preserved patch would duplicate behavior already retained by the authoritative implementation rather than restore missing cognition functionality.

This one-commit branch rebased the durable-state cognition route onto an earlier main by adding the PostgreSQL persisted cognition function and native implementation. Current main retains the same public cognition_observation_execute_persisted route and laplace_pg_cognition_observation_execute_persisted symbol, includes the implementation in the extension, exercises it in PostgreSQL contract tests, and has since evolved the return contract and activation readback around that route. Replaying the older patch would regress the newer persisted-result and activation boundaries rather than recover missing cognition behavior.
